title: Positioning and stacking contexts
description: Learn positioning and stacking contexts by repairing a concrete CSS layout defect, inspecting computed styles and testing mobile and keyboard behavior in a self-contained offline lab.
objectives: Diagnose why positioning and stacking contexts fails in a realistic component
Apply a minimal CSS repair without breaking native HTML semantics
Verify computed styles at narrow and wide widths with repeatable tests
rubric: I reproduced the positioning and stacking contexts failure before changing CSS.
I can explain why the final CSS rule changes actual layout behavior.
I verified the instructor solution in Chromium or DevTools and recorded a limit.
